summary_zh: 離開金圈後，非常值得一來的地方，裡面有停車場，請尋找 “Brúarfoss Parking” 是新建的停車場，曾經是「秘境」，是一個不容易前來的瀑布，而現在已經有了停車場, 路有點小，且這段路並不好開，路上有碎石要小心，但卻省下大把的時間，非常漂亮，有特色的瀑布。
summary_en: After leaving the Golden Circle, this spot is well worth a visit. There is a paid parking lot called “Brúarfoss Parking,” newly built near the waterfall, which used to be hard to reach. The road is narrow and a bit tricky, with loose stones, so drive carefully, but it saves you a lot of time. The waterfall is very beautiful and distinctive.
